title: DK VAT Return Periods regression fix for frequency-aware parsing
summary: The Danish VAT Return Periods parser now correctly handles the official SKAT API XML structure, enabling proper parsing of VAT reporting periods instead of failing with zero records inserted.
key_points: Fixed the Get VAT Periods parser, which expected the wrong XML shape and inserted 0 records even when SKAT returned valid periods
XML shape now follows SKAT's official documentation and sample client schema
Filing deadline now comes from AngivelseFristKalenderFristDato instead of the optional BetalingDato
Added test XML resources for quarterly periods, frequency changes, differing filing and payment dates, missing data and unsupported frequencies
Expanded the tests to check the parser against these expected shapes
